preconditions.description: The number of cities n is a positive integer between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(roads) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n-1 roads, each connecting two distinct cities numbered from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(connected(u, v) for u, v in roads) and connected(1, n) and len(connected_components(roads)) == 1
preconditions.description: The roads form a connected, undirected tree (no cycles, all cities reachable from any other).

postconditions.expression: k == min_days and all(1 <= day <= k for day in day_assignments) and all(1 <= road <= n - 1 for road in day_assignments.values())
postconditions.description: The output consists of k (minimum number of days) followed by k lines, each describing a set of roads repaired on that day. Each road is assigned to exactly one day, and k is the smallest possible.

postconditions.expression: all(len(day_roads) >= 1 for day_roads in day_assignments.values()) and all(road not in other_day_roads for road in day_roads for other_day_roads in day_assignments.values() if day_roads != other_day_roads)
postconditions.description: Each day has at least one road, and no road is assigned to more than one day.

postconditions.expression: all(not overlapping_roads(day_roads) for day_roads in day_assignments.values())
postconditions.description: For each day, the set of roads assigned to it forms a matching (no two roads share a city).

postconditions.expression: all(roads_repaired == set(range(1, n)) for roads_repaired in [set(road for day_roads in day_assignments.values() for road in day_roads)])
postconditions.description: All roads (1 to n-1) are repaired exactly once across all days.
